title: Report - Change Of Commander Of The Japanese Naval Landing Party In Shanghai

page_data.en:
Date December 1, 1931.
Change of Commander of the Japanese Naval Landing Party in
Shanghai.
Made by D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [Signature]

It has been officially announced that the change of
commander of the Japanese Naval Landing Party will take effect
from December 1, 1931.
Baron Captain Shibayama, Commander of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party in Shanghai, to be the commanding officer
of the H.I.J.M.S. "Ikagi".
Baron Captain Samejima to be Commander of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party in Shanghai.

[Signature] M Umemoto
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

SI and Logistics,
Please note and
return here.
[Signature]
7.12.31

* 4/2
Noted
[Signature] 8/12

9 12.
page_data.zh:
日期：1931年12月1日。
上海日本海军陆战队指挥官更迭。
由梅本（D.S. Umemoto）呈报。经 [签名] 转呈

兹正式宣布，日本海军陆战队指挥官之更迭将于1931年12月1日起生效。
现任上海日本海军陆战队指挥官柴山男爵大佐（Baron Captain Shibayama），将调任日本帝国海军“伊加吉”号（H.I.J.M.S. "Ikagi"）舰长。
鮫岛男爵大佐（Baron Captain Samejima）将出任上海日本海军陆战队指挥官。

[签名] M. 梅本
特别处主任

送情报科及后勤科，
请阅知并
退回此处。
[签名]
1931年12月7日

* 4/2
已阅
[签名] 12月8日

12月9日。
